editorial_note: Stacks Definition 7.6.1; index labels and multiplicity are retained as family data, unlike the support set of arrows.
text: Let C be a category. A family of morphisms with a fixed target comprises an object U of C, a set I and morphisms f_i:U_i→U for each i∈I; the index set I may be empty.

context: Stacks Definition 7.6.2. The family-of-arrows coverage data and set-sized condition must not be identified literally with a topology of covering sieves.
editorial_note: Stacks Definition 7.6.2. The family-of-arrows coverage data and set-sized condition must not be identified literally with a topology of covering sieves.
text: A site in the Stacks family-based convention is a category C with a set Cov(C) of families of morphisms with common target. Cov(C) contains singleton families of isomorphisms and is closed under compositional refinement and base change of coverings along morphisms, with the needed fiber products existing.
